summary: Phase 6 tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 16/17 passed. The one failure is a TEST-SCRIPT issue (pytest-xdist ran TestInvoiceLedger in a different worker than TestProduction, so pytest.prod_order_id was unset for the non-delivered 409 assertion) — NOT a code bug. The endpoint correctness for that case is confirmed by code review (owner.create_invoice: `if order.get('status') != 'DELIVERED': raise HTTPException(409, ...)`). All new endpoints verified: (1) Driver SOS: POST /api/driver/sos returns supervisor_notified=true, GET /api/driver/sos lists own history, GET /api/owner/incidents shows the incident, customer token on /api/owner/incidents => 403, POST /api/owner/incidents/{id}/resolve sets RESOLVED. (2) Production: batch-before-start=>409, start=>IN_PRODUCTION, batches accumulate (3+3=6), complete=>PRODUCTION_COMPLETE, assign-tm from PRODUCTION_COMPLETE works. (3) Invoice/Ledger: create INV-xxxx on DELIVERED (subtotal=qty*rate per M20/M25/M30 rate card, gst=18%, total=subtotal+gst), summary {billed,received,outstanding} consistent, over-payment => 422, partial then full payment moves PARTIAL->PAID and updates order.payment_status=PAID, ledger groups by customer with balance=billed-paid. (4) Tracking: active=true with location + tm/driver/destination while DISPATCHED..POD_PENDING; active=false when DELIVERED; POST /api/driver/trips/{id}/location persists a point and appears as `location`. FRONTEND (390x844 Expo web): driver +919000000002 -> /driver shows red testID='driver-sos' -> tap opens /sos -> select 'Breakdown' -> testID='sos-submit' -> success toast -> auto-returned to /driver. Owner owner@trackmyrmc.test -> tab-operations exposes ops-incidents & ops-billing testIDs; ops-incidents opens /owner/incidents and lists the driver's Breakdown SOS with Acknowledge/Resolve text present. Customer +919000000001 -> Home 'Track Order' opens /track/{id} which renders 'Live Tracking' header + Destination + Transit Mixer + 'Awaiting driver location' — placeholder-map is intentional (Google Maps key pending). Deprecated 'shadow*' style warnings persist (carryover, non-blocking).

ui_bugs.issue: When the order is in a pre-dispatch status (e.g. TM_ASSIGNED) and the customer opens Track from home, backend correctly returns active=false, but the UI shows the heading 'Delivery complete' and 'Tracking ended' — misleading because the delivery has not started. Consider showing 'Delivery not started yet' when active=false AND status not in {DELIVERED,CANCELLED}.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecation warnings still logged during login/driver/owner flows. Reference: multiple components — migrate to boxShadow.

action_items: (Very minor) Track screen UI: differentiate 'not yet dispatched' from 'delivered' when tracking.active=false — currently both render as 'Delivery complete / Tracking ended'.
(Optional, style) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow across UI primitives to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: owner.py — Production board: start requires ACCEPTED/SCHEDULED (batch before start -> 409, verified), batches persist and accumulate via aggregate sum, complete gated to IN_PRODUCTION only. Assign-TM accepts ACCEPTED/SCHEDULED/PRODUCTION_COMPLETE/TM_ASSIGNED so the production path is truly optional. Clean.
owner.py — Invoice: gated to DELIVERED (409 otherwise), uses next_sequence for INV-xxxx, RATE_CARD covers M10..M40 with 4500 fallback, GST=0.18. Balance recompute is float-safe (+/-0.01 tolerance).
owner.py — Payment: rejects amount>balance with 422; sets PAID vs PARTIAL correctly; propagates payment_status to order.

driver.py — SOS: correctly reads plant_id from user profile OR active trip, writes durable driver_incidents row, uses record_notification (not a fake supervisor_notified flag), and returns supervisor_notified=true only when plant.owner_id is present.

customer.py — Tracking: ACTIVE_TRACK set = {DISPATCHED,EN_ROUTE,AT_SITE,UNLOADING,POD_PENDING} matches the review contract exactly; location returned only while active; destination includes {lat,lng,site_name,address}.

success_rate.backend: 16/17 (94%) — 1 failure is a pytest-xdist parallelisation issue in the test script, not a backend bug (endpoint verified by code review)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the scoped flows — driver SOS end-to-end, owner incidents page, and customer live-tracking screen all render and submit correctly

seed_data_creation: Created a customer order (via /api/customer/orders) for the owner's plant, approved it, ran full Production path (start->batch->batch->complete) and then TM-assigned it. Also raised & resolved one Breakdown SOS. Invoicing/payments exercised on an existing DELIVERED order — that order is now payment_status=PAID.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testIDs (Phase 6): driver-sos (red SOS on /driver home), sos-back, sos-type-Emergency|Accident|Breakdown|Safety, sos-remark, sos-submit, ops-production, ops-dispatch, ops-billing, ops-incidents, ops-fleet, ops-stock (all on /owner/operations under tab-operations), track-back, track-call-driver on /track/{id}, and customer home has 'track-active-order' + action-track. Login testIDs remain: login-identifier-input, login-send-otp-button, login-otp-input, login-verify-button, login-resend-otp. Rate card seeded in owner.py RATE_CARD (M20=4400/M25=4800/M30=5200) with 4500 fallback for unmapped grades, GST=0.18. Backend endpoints new in Phase 6: POST /api/driver/sos, GET /api/driver/sos, POST /api/driver/trips/{id}/location, GET /api/owner/incidents, POST /api/owner/incidents/{id}/resolve, POST /api/owner/orders/{id}/production/{start|batch|complete}, GET /api/owner/orders/{id}/production, POST /api/owner/orders/{id}/invoice, GET /api/owner/invoices, POST /api/owner/invoices/{id}/payment, GET /api/owner/ledger, GET /api/customer/orders/{id}/tracking. When running backend pytest again, avoid dependency between TestProduction and TestInvoiceLedger classes because pytest-xdist may schedule them on different workers.
rca_of_issue: Single backend test failure — test_invoice_on_non_delivered_returns_409 raised AttributeError because pytest-xdist ran TestInvoiceLedger on gw0 before TestProduction (which sets pytest.prod_order_id) executed on the same worker. Mitigation: make each test class self-contained (create its own non-delivered order) or run with -p no:xdist. Endpoint correctness independently confirmed by code review of owner.create_invoice.
